evidence.issuer: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways
evidence.locator: Transfer of ownership on death of owner
evidence.passage: may for a period of three months, use the vehicle as if it has been transferred to him

procedure_title: Put a vehicle in your name after the owner has died
statement: If you have told the RTO, you may use the vehicle for three months as if it had been transferred to you.
step_action: Tell the transport office that the owner has died.
